summary: Fortis Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 press release, interim financial statements and MD&A for the period ended September 30, 2026. Reported net earnings were $474 million, or $0.92 per share, versus $0.81 a year earlier. The release introduced a 2027-2031 capital plan of $32.2 billion, supporting 7.5% rate base growth, and announced a 4% increase in the fourth quarter common dividend with 4-6% annual growth guidance extended through 2031. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation or deal mechanics are present; watch quarterly rate base execution and regulatory outcomes, not arbitrage.
